messages:
Alex (Sales): Heads-up — HeliosCorp returned our vendor security review and flagged the BCP/DR section. They want a short copy-paste block for RTO/RPO, backup cadence, failover steps, SLA history, and DR test evidence. Can SRE + Legal craft something we can paste into their questionnaire? :pray:

Mei (Solutions Eng): I can draft. Quick Q: they checked the "RTO <= 1 hour" box. Do we ever commit to that for any offering out-of-the-box? Also clarify hosted vs private backup ownership.

Tom (SRE): Short tiered answers we can paste:
- Hosted API: Operated for high availability with automated routing; we do not make contractual RTO/RPO commitments for Hosted. Typical operational recovery from infra incidents is measured in hours and varies by incident.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): SLA-backed availability. Standard: 99.9% monthly uptime. Premium: 99.95% monthly. Operational RTO targets for a full-environment failover are typically 2-4 hours depending on topology and pre-provisioned warm pools.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): Customer-managed. RTO/RPO are defined during onboarding and written into the Statement of Work. We provide runbooks, snapshot tooling, and guidance for sub-hour RPO designs.

Tom (SRE): Backups & RPO (pasteable bullets):
- Control plane metadata and audit logs: retention and retention windows are contract-configurable (examples: 90 days / 365 days).
- Hosted request data: short-term persistence; Hosted does not include an RPO guarantee unless a Dedicated backup add-on is contracted.
- Dedicated: point-in-time backups are available; recommended cadence to approach sub-hour RPO is daily full plus hourly incremental snapshots (customer configuration required).
- Private: customer controls snapshot cadence and replication; RPO depends on customer architecture and configuration.

Mei (Solutions Eng): Can you give a concise failover sequence we can paste (avoid absolutes)?

Tom (SRE): Failover sequence (concise):
1) Health detection and automated traffic routing away from impacted nodes/region.
2) Best-effort cache / KV prefix fallback to reduce recompute.
3) Promote warm-standby Dedicated pools if provisioned.
4) DNS / edge failover for Dedicated and Private deployments when configured.
(Note: exact timing depends on customer topology, DNS TTLs, and provisioned capacity.)

Jordan (Legal): Procurement-safe pasteable paragraph (please use this as the official response):
"Redwood Inference operates a tiered service model. Hosted API deployments are operated for high availability and automated failover where feasible but do not include contractual RTO/RPO commitments. Dedicated capacity is provided with contractual uptime SLAs (Standard 99.9%, Premium 99.95%) and documented recovery procedures; specific RTO/RPO values, backup cadences, and runbooks are negotiated and set forth in the Service Addendum. Private (VPC / on-prem) deployments' recovery objectives are agreed case-by-case. Data protection controls, including encryption in transit and at rest and audit logging, are provided. Statements herein are subject to the terms of the Master Services Agreement and applicable Service Addendum."

Mei (Solutions Eng): They also want proof of DR testing. Tom, short line we can attach?

Tom (SRE): Use this: "We conduct quarterly DR tabletop exercises and annual live failover tests for Dedicated pools. Private customers coordinate DR tests with their ops teams. Anonymized 12‑month availability metrics and a one‑page summary of the most recent tabletop exercise (with action items) can be provided upon request."

Jordan (Legal): Minor edit: add the final sentence: "All responses are subject to contractual terms" — included in the paragraph above.

Mei (Solutions Eng): OK I'll bundle: (1) Jordan's legal paragraph; (2) Tom's backup/RPO bullets; (3) the failover sequence; (4) the DR testing line and offer to attach anonymized availability metrics and a one‑page DR summary. Will cc Legal when I send to HeliosProcurement.

compliance-bot: DR-tabletop scheduled: 2026-06-10T16:00:00Z (reminder 7d)

Alex (Sales): Action items: Mei send the pasteable answers + runbook excerpt to HeliosProcurement (cc Jordan), Tom prepare anonymized 12‑month Dedicated availability numbers and the 1‑pager DR summary, Jordan sign off final language. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
